claim_scores.rationale: Defines `supported_params` to include `response_format` only on the two capable variants, and verifies the plain variant receives no `response_format` kwarg.
The `json_mode_lm` variant sets `supported_params` true and `supports_response_schema` false, then asserts `response_format == {"type": "json_object"}`.
The `structured_lm` variant advertises both capabilities and asserts the captured `response_format` is a subclass of `pydantic.BaseModel`.
`forward` captures `**kwargs` into `self.calls` and returns an OpenAI chat-completion-shaped fake response whose message content is a JSON string.
Instantiates three LM variants, runs the same `dspy.Predict` with `dspy.JSONAdapter` through each, and asserts/prints schema class vs JSON mode vs absent hint.
